notes.title: 2025 Dev Log & Plans
notes.content:
[h2]Regarding the Past Year - My Deepest Apologies:[/h2]

Since the 2023 New Year announcement, I haven't released any updates or official notices about Eve of Souls: Static Pod on Steam or other public platforms. This has understandably caused confusion and dissatisfaction among almost all players. This behavior constitutes a severe breach of my previous commitments, and for that, I'm profoundly sorry. I'll try to explain the specific circumstances of these two years in this announcement.

[h2]Why Has the Game Update Been Continuously Delayed?[/h2]

Simply put: major disagreements with a core team member midway through development, coupled with my own insufficient capabilities, lack of willpower, and unexpected health issues severely impacted my life planning. (From 2020 to the present, I still haven't been able to reintegrate into "normal life." Even minor lapses like forgetting medication on time or encountering emotionally triggering content can cause severe adverse reactions.)
I've generally avoided discussing specific medical conditions and personal matters, as those could be seen as excuses or attempts to garner sympathy. However, if any players are interested in these topics, you're welcome to join our official QQ group [367451352] for more direct and casual communication with me or other players.

[h2]What Exactly Has the Developer Been Doing?[/h2]

Shamefully, the answer might be "almost nothing" - or rather, I've been:
• Actively pursuing treatment and striving to take medication on schedule
• Reporting physical conditions and attempting to return to normal life (socializing, exercise, simple remote work, etc.)
• Using video games as distraction therapy
Since October 2024, I've been researching suitable hospitals for proper rehabilitation. On March 1, 2025, I completed my first 13-day hospitalization for observation and treatment. My condition has now stabilized somewhat with adjusted medication, and I've learned some self-protection/recovery methods. I've begun more active follow-up consultations, hoping this trend continues.

[h2]Future Plans for <Eve of Souls: Static Pod>?[/h2]

I deeply regret that I can't make any commitments regarding resuming work/updating timelines. However, I haven't abandoned this project. When I can stably return to "normal life and work/study routines," my first major task will be completing Eve of Souls: Static Pod - a goal reaffirmed through discussions with my medical team.

[h2]Final Thanks[/h2]
To all players who've waited, cared, supported, or criticized during this period - thank you from the bottom of my heart. Love you all. ❤

[*] Darkness will no longer bring your Sp cap below 50%

notes.title: Chinese Beta Test Branch Lauched!
notes.content:
[h3]About the Official Release[/h3]
- Sorry for the long delay since the last update! 
  - After opening the beta test, we plan to keep 2 round of development-testing in every 2-3 days throughout July. 
  - We plan to bring you Chap 4 before August ends in the official branch. 
  - As planned, we decided to increase the price of the game slightly after every big update until it reaches 25 CNY. Those who have already bought the game don’t need to pay extra. 
  - Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, my courses abroad were canceled. My personal state has finally been stabling. So I’ll have more time to focus on the development of the game. 
  - Again, sorry for the wait, let me explain what this update is all about. 

[h3]What is a beta test branch? [/h3]
- It can be narrowly interpret as test version of new content. 
  - Compare to the main version, you can experience new content much faster here. 
  - Some content on this branch is not widely tested, so there might be bugs. That’s why your feedback is even more valued here. 

[h3]Why test branch? [/h3]
- To complete the game, there are still massive amount of work and localization that need to be done. For those who would like to experience it firsthand, I decided to open this test branch. 
  - To let you monitor our progress much closer
  - To gather more feedback and speed up the development cycle. 

[h3]How to enter test branch?[/h3]
  - Right click on the game in Library, select Property in the drop down menu. Select “BETAS” in the popped up window. Select [beta] and wait for Steam client to update the game. 

[h3]Attention![/h3]
  - Savedata between release version and beta version is not interchangeable.

notes.title: Happy New Year (A bit late tho’)
notes.content:
[b]My fellow gamers! 
Although it’s a little late for New Year greetings, I wish you all the best. Please take the time to get some rest and do something you always wanted. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33517796/f3c9a1531b611d788a8f2a16e5964ce0769c8c04.jpg[/img]
I’m sorry for keeping you guys waiting for the updates of the games. 
It’s pretty slow I know but I’ve been putting my everything into developing. I’m adding new puzzles to smooth out the game more. It’s not ready yet but it’ll be the best I can do when it’s ready. Thanks for the wait! [/b]

[h3][i]Why is the development going so slowly:[/i][/h3]
[i]I apologize and feel very shameful about it. Physical inconveniences aside, it’s more mentally challenging than I thought. 

The pressure got greater when I decided to present the game to you all. 

Whenever I go try another game of this genre, I feel deeply depressed about the imperfections in the game. 
To perfect them, it requires lots and lots of energy and inspirations. 
To ignore this, I can’t really sleep at night knowing that they exist. 
So in the developing of this game, I find myself often in this anxious and annoyed state. 

In the meanwhile, both I and my ex-partner in developing this game got caught up in it, emotionally speaking, that we felt the pressure tripled or maybe more, then lead to us parting ways as you all know. 

So now, it’s just me who’s been handling the developing alone. 
I could handle the workload to be clear but most of the time after I launched the engine, I felt utterly pressured and depressed which often lead to nothing else than giving up. 
I’m not saying this to justify what I did but to let you know what my metal state is. I’ll try all I have to conquer the metal barrier and start to get things done. Again I apologize for the slow development and me rambling on. 
Please give me a bit more time and I promise you to present you with a game you wouldn’t regret buying. 
As always thank you all for the support and kind words! [/i]

notes.title: Major Update V0.65.5 *IMPORTANT*
notes.content:
What’s up fellow gamers! I’m happy to announce that the new patch is here! 

[b]Direction for This Patch: [/b]
Drastically improved the experience of the first 3 chapters, added new features and laid foundation for the 4th and 5th chapter. 

[b]Summary (In case it’s TL DR): [/b]
-	The length of the HP bar will get longer as the Max HP increases. 
-	Significantly increase the move speed during daily routine. 
-	Remade some of the night scenes in Chap 1&2 with new features! 
-	Remade the lighting system, the game now supports Ray Tracing…Just kidding, but you’ll have a clearer view in the dark scenes. 
-	Remade the hiding system, the cabinet that seemed to be useless may as well save your life! 
-	Optimized how attributes of Sha, the daily routines will now make a different. 
-	Significantly balanced and optimized the difficulty of the game, Chap 3 will be a lot easier now. 

[b]Details: [/b]
1. The Lamp Trap now deals 2 types of damage: it’ll instantly kill anyone who stands in the inner circle where the lamp drops down to; it’ll deal a little bit of splash damage to anyone who stands in the outer circle where the lamps drops down to. 
2. You can Dash now at the night of Chap 1. 
3. The Tarot [Justice] will only restore your SP to a safe instead of full. 
4. Significantly decreased the speed of the Red Claw, it’ll stop for a short while after each attack. 
5. The Giant Black Monster will not kill you instantly now but will deal tons of psych damage when it’s near you. 
6. The Tarot [Moon] will grant you x2 endurance of psych damage. 
7. Added more interactive objects and collectibles.  
8. Remade the hiding system, you can now hide inside the closets at ANY TIME, even when chased. But you’ll lose SANs very quickly. 
9. Optimized the scenes in Chap 3, you’ll not be instantly blocked by monster when you come out of a door.
10. The experience of the hidden level in Chap 2 will be more exciting.

notes.title: Patch Notice
notes.content:
Thank all of you for the testing and the feedback this month. We've made a few changes according to your demands and preferences. The following is the updated content: 

1. Reduced the laggy feel when moving.
2. Added new animation and stepping sound to the move "sprinting".
3. Replaced a few BGMs and added some more to provide a more immersive experience. 
4. Replaced and added new UIs. 
5. Fixed the bug that caused wrongly display of numbers of items. 
6. Fixed the bug that caused wrongly display of HP/SP.
7. Enhanced the effectiveness of "Bandages", one will cure all "injuries". 
8. Reduced the remaining "injuries" when taking damage. For example, when taking 20 damage, you'll now have only 15 "injuries". 
9. After game over, it'll show you the saving/loading screen instead of the main title. 
10. Significantly reduced the times you need to try to break to door in scene 2 (from 12 to 6). 

We're still testing and optimizing the final product. There will also be another beta test for all of you. Please stay tuned.
